judgment.notes: Both E002 applications have the stated endpoint, exponent, spatial regularity and derivative premises. Airy signs, projections and inverse derivative agree with Cop; normalization changes only a fixed constant. Details are in A001 and A002.

S001 gives every negative-norm slot and directly includes arbitrary continuous inputs with the stipulated distributional derivative: E002 at alpha_s=0 already has precisely this regularity, so no density claim in the time-derivative norm is needed. S002 gives the static bound and its bounded extension by the displayed telescoping/completeness argument. Zero-length intervals have zero output. Fixed rescaling and extension preserve uniformity in interval location and Fourier support.
